qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Microbiology/ Biochemistry/ Biotechnology, M.Sc./ MPH / MHA/ M.Pharm/ Pharm.D, Bachelor's Degree, Graduate/Master's in Public Health/ Pharm.D
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical): Ph.D. in Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology from a recognized university with 5 years of R&D/teaching experience in the relevant subject after Ph.D. OR First Class MPH/Pharm D/Master's degree in Microbiology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Pharmacy/MHA from a recognized university with 8 years of R&D/teaching experience OR Second Class M.Sc./MPH with Ph.D. in the relevant subject from a recognized university with 8 years of R&D/teaching experience post qualification plus 2 years of experience in managing R&D projects effectively in a team. Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical): M.Sc. in Life Sciences/MPH/MHA/M.Pharm./Pharm.D. with 4 years of experience in the relevant area. Administrative Officer: Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent with a minimum of 03 years of experience under the Government Department/Statutory or Autonomous bodies/Universities/Public Sector undertakings and having knowledge of MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point and MS Excel OR Retired Officers of the rank of Section Officer/Under Secretary to the Government of India. Field Officer: Graduate in Public Health from a recognized university with 3 years of work experience from a recognized institution OR Master's degree in Public Health or Pharm D (Doctor of Pharmacy) from a recognized institution.

Administrative Officer: Bachelor's Degree or its equivalent with a minimum of 03 years of experience under the Government Department/Statutory or Autonomous bodies/Universities/Public Sector undertakings and having knowledge of MS Office, MS Word, MS Power Point and MS Excel OR Retired Officers of the rank of Section Officer/Under Secretary to the Government of India. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NIHR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ICMR NIHR?
faq.answer: ICMR NIHR has announced a total of 5 vacancies for various posts, including Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical), Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Administrative Officer, and Field Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from a Bachelor's Degree to a Ph.D. in relevant fields like Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Public Health, and Pharmacy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) post is Rs. 78,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICMR NIHR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at ICMR National Institute of Health Research, Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Written Test, Skill Test, Document Verification, and finally, the preparation of a Merit List.
